responsibility: Verifies terminal-side markdown rendering by testing line-wrapping and indentation behavior and by comparing rendered termcolor output for a sample markdown document against the blessed expected byte stream.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `markdown/term.rs`, which implements terminal markdown rendering, this file is the renderer test suite: it drives `write_wrapping` and full `MdStream` rendering and compares the emitted bytes against expected wrapped and blessed output.
